content: Yusufe báiyaindore sin diye

Toi Yusuf nizor ḍake tiyat aššilde hitarar sarme nizore ar sõli raki no fare, edde guzori hodde, "Ãr sarmottu beggunore niyolai do!" Henot hibar ḍake ar kiye tiyat no aššil. Toi hetunot Yusufe báiyaindor hãse nizor foriso diye.
Ar hibaye eto ḍõr gori guzori hainde ze Mišoriyo okkole hin funniye, edde Feruwanor góror ma he babute funniye.
Bade Yusufe hibar báiyaindore hodde, "Ãi Yusuf; ãr baf ki ehono basi ase?" Kintu hibar báiyainde hibare zuwab di no fare, kiyollahoile hitara hibar sarme ḍoraye.
Yusufe hibar báiyaindore hodde, "Meherbani gori tũwara ãr ḍake aiyo." Hitara hibar ḍake giye, toi hibaye hodde, "Ãi tũwarar bái Yusuf, zare tũwara Mišorot beisso.
Ar tũwara ãre eṛe beissode hiyanolla ehon tũwarar monot duk no ainno otóba nizor uwore rag no goijjo; foran okkol basaibolla Allaye tũwarar age ãre eṛe defeṛaiye.
Kiyollahoile dešot raṭ soledde ehon dui bosor oiye, ar aro fãs bosor saš ba fošol da no oibo.
Kintu Allaye tũwarar bongšore duniyait basai rakibolla edde moha uddaror duwara tũwarare basaibolla, tũwarar age ãre defeṛaiye.
"Hetolla, ãre eṛe tũwara defeṛaiyo no, kintu Allaye. Hibaye ãre Feruwanor bafor zagat, edde hibar hár góror malik, edde šara Mišor dešor uwore šašongoroya goijje.
Tũwara toratori uwore ãr bafor hãse zo edde hibare ho: 'Tũwar fut Yusufe endilla hoiye: Allaye ãre šara Mišor dešor malik goijje; tũi eṛe lamat ãr hãse aiyo, deri no goijjo.
Tũi, tũwar futziyain edde natifuti, tũwar goru sool, ar za kissu ase beggun loi Gušen elehat takifariba; ar ãr ḍake ogai,
Ar heṛe ãi tũwarare deha funa goriyum, kiyollahoile raṭ aro fãs bosor ase. Ar no oilede tũi edde tũwarar góror guštiṭiya, zin ase beggune hošto faiba.'
"Ar so, tũwara edde ãr bái Benyamin, tũwara nizor suke dekor, ze ãi nizor muke tũwarar loi hota hoidde;
Mišorot ãr hondilla ijjot, edde zaha kissu tũwara deikko, beggun ãr bafore hoiba, ar hibare hara eṛe lamat loianogoi."
Toi hibaye hibar bái Benyaminor golat dori hainde, ar Benyamine o hibar golat dori hainde.
Ar hibaye báiyain beggunore suma diye edde hitarar golat dori hainde. Tarfore hibar báiyainde hibar loi hotabattara hoiye.
Yusufor báiyain aiššede, ei hóbor Feruwanor górot fõsiyore, Feruwan edde hitar gulam okkol beggune kuši oiye.
Feruwane Yusufore hodde, "Tui tor báiyain okkolore ho, 'Tũwara endilla goro: Tũwarar zanuwargunor fiṛot haiddo lo edde Kenanot baisa do,
ar tũwarar bafore edde tũwarar nizor nizor góror manuš okkolore loi ãr hãse aiyogoi. Ãi tũwarare Mišoror uttom zaga diyum, edde tũwara dešor barik ziniš okkol hái fariba.'
"Tui hitarare hokum dibi, 'Tũwara endilla goro: Tũwarar bou fuwaindolla Mišorottu gũra gari okkol loizo, ar hitarare edde tũwarar bafore loi aiyogoi.
Ar tũwarar malamalolla no bafiyo, kiyollahoile fura Mišoror uttom ziniš tũwarar oibo.'"
Toi Israilor futain okkole hendilla goijje. Yusufe razar hokum mozin hitarare gũra gari diye, ar hibaye hitarare fõtolla hána o diye.
Hibaye fotti zonore noya hor diye, kintu Benyaminore tin šot rufar ṭĩya edde fãs zura hor diye.
Ar bafolla hibaye in okkol defeṛaiye: došwa modda gadar fiṛot gori Mišoror barik ziniš okkol, ar došwa miyala gadar fiṛot gori gĩyũ edde ruṭi ar bafor baisalla haiddo.
Tarfore hibaye báiyaindore bidai goijje, ar hitara baisa diyar šomot hibaye hodde, "Fõtot hoijja-hanḍal no goijjo!"
Toi hitara Mišorottu niyoliyore uwore Kenanot hitarar baf Yakubor hãse aišše.
Edde hitara bafore hoiye, hodde, "Yusuf ehono zinda ase, ar šara Mišor dešor uwore hite šašongoroya oiye." Kintu bafor dil sorot taigiyegoi, kiyollahoile hitara hota hibattu biššaš no lage.

Ar Yusufe hitarare hoilde he hár hota okkol zehon hitara hibare hoiye, edde hibare boiloizaibolla Yusufe gũra gari okkol defeṛaiyede hin zehon deikke, henot hitarar baf Yakubor ruh uwafes zinda oi uiṭṭe.
Toi Israile hodde, "Iyan beši oiye! Ãr fut Yusuf ehono zinda ase; Ãi zaiyore moribar age hitare saiyum."
